method: Each page image was individually opened and visually read by this reviewer at 130 dpi. pdftotext was used only as a supplement (unresolved-reference scan). Mathematical content was checked against the LaTeX source, not only the image.

Section 1.2 credit boundary, Section 1.3 motivation examples with stated limits; Section 2 opens. Noticeable bottom whitespace before Section 2.1, which starts on page 4; cosmetic only.

Bit-complexity argument with deterministic ties (O10); Appendix A table start, first 6 declarations. No defect.

Table continued (16 declarations total, all present in frozen RCS128.lean); A.1 limits (formal O1-O7); A.2 diagnostics not proof, zero multi-child flipped batches disclosed. Long identifier odd_core_from_previous_failure wraps at an underscore; acceptable.

References 6-12, URL breaks fit, no clipping; normal final-page whitespace.

summary: 17/17 pages read. No clipping, overfull text, missing glyph, unresolved reference, or broken mathematics. Cosmetic notes only (MR-O1, MR-O2, page-3 whitespace).
